paragraphs.text: So the Sea was before them, mountains on either side, and the enemies at their back: yet they obeyed God, and were delivered.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Josephus writes that besides those chariots, there were 50,000 horsemen, and 80,000 footmen.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: They who earlier had rejoiced in their deliverance, being now in danger, are afraid.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Such is the impatience of the flesh, that it cannot wait for God's appointed time.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Only put your trust in God without grudging or doubting.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Thus in temptation faith fights against the flesh, and cries with inward groanings to the Lord.

paragraphs.text: The cloud gave light to the Israelites, but to the Egyptians it was darkness, so that their two groups could not join together.
